flower-veil.textEn: This side's Grass types can't have stats lowered or status inflicted by other Pokemon.
flower-veil.textEs: Evita que los Pokémon de tipo Planta aliados sufran problemas de estado o que les bajen sus características.
flower-veil.detail: Grass-type Pokemon on this Pokemon's side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.
flower-veil.detailEs: Protege a los Pokémon aliados de tipo Planta de que otros Pokémon les bajen las características.
flower-veil.detailZh: 防止我方草属性宝可梦的能力被其他宝可梦降低。
flower-veil.detailPt: Protege os Pokémon aliados do tipo Planta de terem seus atributos diminuídos por outros Pokémon.

grass-pelt.textEn: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
grass-pelt.textEs: Aumenta su Defensa si hay un campo de hierba en el terreno de combate.
grass-pelt.detail: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
grass-pelt.detailEs: Aumenta la Defensa mientras el Campo de Hierba está en efecto.
grass-pelt.detailZh: 在青草场地状态下，防御提升。
grass-pelt.detailPt: Aumenta a Defesa enquanto o Grassy Terrain estiver em efeito.

fur-coat.textEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques físicos del rival.
fur-coat.detailEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño de los ataques físicos.
fur-coat.detailZh: 受到的物理攻击伤害减半。
fur-coat.detailPt: Reduz pela metade o dano de ataques físicos.

stance-change.textEn: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.
stance-change.textEs: Adopta la Forma Filo al lanzar un ataque, o bien la Forma Escudo si usa el movimiento Escudo Real.
stance-change.detail: If this Pokemon is an Aegislash, it changes to Blade Forme before using an attacking move, and changes to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.
stance-change.detailEs: Cambia a Aegislash a la Forma Filo antes de usar un movimiento de daño, o a la Forma Escudo antes de usar Escudo Real.
stance-change.detailZh: 坚盾剑怪在使用伤害招式前变为刀剑形态，在使用王者盾牌前变为盾牌形态。
stance-change.detailPt: Muda Aegislash para a Forma Lâmina antes de usar um movimento de dano, ou para a Forma Escudo antes de usar King's Shield.

aroma-veil.textEn: Protects user/allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
aroma-veil.textEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados de ataques que impiden elegir movimientos.
aroma-veil.detail: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.
aroma-veil.detailEs: Protege a los aliados contra los movimientos que afectan a su estado mental.
aroma-veil.detailZh: 保护我方宝可梦不受影响精神状态的招式的影响。
aroma-veil.detailPt: Protege os aliados contra movimentos que afetam seu estado mental.

tough-claws.textEn: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.
tough-claws.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de contacto.
tough-claws.detail: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.
tough-claws.detailEs: Potencia los movimientos que hacen contacto a 1.33× su potencia.
tough-claws.detailZh: 将接触类招式的威力强化至1.33×。
tough-claws.detailPt: Fortalece movimentos que fazem contato para 1.33× seu poder.

refrigerate.textEn: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice type and have 1.2x power.
refrigerate.textEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hielo y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
refrigerate.detail: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
refrigerate.detailEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal del portador en movimientos de tipo Hielo. Los movimientos cambiados por esta habilidad tienen 1.3× su potencia.
refrigerate.detailZh: 将持有者的一般属性招式变为冰属性招式。被此特性改变的招式威力变为1.3×。
refrigerate.detailPt: Transforma os movimentos do tipo Normal do portador em movimentos do tipo Gelo. Movimentos alterados por esta habilidade têm 1.3× seu poder.

pixilate.textEn: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy type and have 1.2x power.
pixilate.textEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hada y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
pixilate.detail: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
pixilate.detailEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal del portador en movimientos de tipo Hada. Los movimientos cambiados por esta habilidad tienen 1.3× su potencia.
pixilate.detailZh: 将持有者的一般属性招式变为妖精属性招式。被此特性改变的招式威力变为1.3×。
pixilate.detailPt: Transforma os movimentos do tipo Normal do portador em movimentos do tipo Fada. Movimentos alterados por esta habilidade têm 1.3× seu poder.

fairy-aura.textEn: While this Pokemon is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33x power.
fairy-aura.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Hada.
fairy-aura.detail: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.
fairy-aura.detailEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Hada de todos los Pokémon, tanto aliados como rivales.
fairy-aura.detailZh: 强化所有我方和对手方宝可梦的妖精属性招式。
fairy-aura.detailPt: Fortalece os movimentos do tipo Fada de todos os Pokémon aliados e adversários.

dark-aura.textEn: While this Pokemon is active, a Dark move used by any Pokemon has 1.33x power.
dark-aura.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Siniestro.
dark-aura.detail: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Dark-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.
dark-aura.detailEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Siniestro de todos los Pokémon, tanto aliados como rivales.
dark-aura.detailZh: 强化所有我方和对手方宝可梦的恶属性招式。
dark-aura.detailPt: Fortalece os movimentos do tipo Sombrio de todos os Pokémon aliados e adversários.

aura-break.textEn: While this Pokemon is active, the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier is 0.75x.
aura-break.textEs: Invierte los efectos de las auras, por lo que baja la potencia de ciertos movimientos en vez de subirla.
aura-break.detail: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura Abilities are reversed, multiplying the power of Dark- and Fairy-type moves, respectively, by 3/4 instead of 1.33.
aura-break.detailEs: Mientras este Pokémon está en el campo, Aura Oscura y Aura Feérica debilitan los movimientos de sus tipos respectivos a 2/3 de su potencia, en lugar de potenciarlos.
aura-break.detailZh: 当此宝可梦在场时，暗黑气场和妖精气场会使其各自对应属性的招式威力减弱至2/3，而非强化。
aura-break.detailPt: Enquanto este Pokémon está em campo, Dark Aura e Fairy Aura enfraquecem os movimentos de seus respectivos tipos para 2/3 do seu poder, em vez de fortalecê-los.

queenly-majesty.textEn: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
queenly-majesty.textEs: Intimida al objetivo y le impide usar movimientos con prioridad.
queenly-majesty.detail: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
queenly-majesty.detailEs: Cuando un Pokémon rival intenta usar un movimiento que tiene como objetivo a este Pokémon o a un aliado, y ese movimiento tiene prioridad, fallará.
queenly-majesty.detailZh: 当对手宝可梦试图使用以此宝可梦或其同伴为目标的先制招式时，该招式会失败。
queenly-majesty.detailPt: Quando um Pokémon adversário tenta usar um movimento que tem como alvo este Pokémon ou um aliado, e esse movimento tem prioridade, ele falhará.

triage.textEn: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
triage.textEs: Da prioridad a los movimientos que restauran PS.
triage.detail: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
triage.detailEs: Los movimientos curativos de este Pokémon ven su prioridad aumentada en 3.
triage.detailZh: 此宝可梦的回复类招式的先制度提升3。
triage.detailPt: Os movimentos de cura deste Pokémon têm sua prioridade aumentada em 3.

emergency-exit.textEn: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
emergency-exit.textEs: Abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad para evitar males mayores.
emergency-exit.detail: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.
emergency-exit.detailEs: Después de que este Pokémon sea golpeado por un movimiento, si ese movimiento hizo que sus PS cayeran por debajo de la mitad, se retira del combate.
emergency-exit.detailZh: 此宝可梦被招式击中后，如果该招式使其HP降至一半以下，它会退场换下。
emergency-exit.detailPt: Depois que este Pokémon é atingido por um movimento, se esse movimento fez o HP deste Pokémon cair abaixo da metade, ele é trocado.

rks-system.textEn: If this Pokemon is a Silvally, its type changes to match its held Memory.
rks-system.textEs: Cambia su tipo según el disco que lleve instalado.
rks-system.detail: If this Pokemon is a Silvally, its type changes to match its held Memory.
rks-system.detailEs: Cambia el tipo de este Pokémon para que coincida con el disco que lleva. Esta habilidad no se puede copiar, reemplazar ni anular. Esta habilidad solo tiene efecto para Silvally.
rks-system.detailZh: 将此宝可梦的属性变为与其携带的存储碟相对应。此特性无法被复制、替换或无效化。此特性仅对银伴战兽生效。
rks-system.detailPt: Muda o tipo deste Pokémon para corresponder à Memory que ele está segurando. Esta habilidade não pode ser copiada, substituída ou anulada. Esta habilidade só tem efeito para Silvally.

disguise.textEn: (Mimikyu only) The first hit it takes is blocked, and it takes 1/8 HP damage instead.
disguise.textEs: Puede eludir un ataque valiéndose de la tela que le cubre el cuerpo una vez por combate.
disguise.detail: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.
disguise.detailEs: Si este Pokémon está en su Forma Disfrazada y recibe daño de un movimiento, cambia a su Forma Descubierta y el daño se previene. Otros efectos no se previenen. Esta habilidad no se puede copiar ni reemplazar. Esta habilidad solo tiene efecto para Mimikyu.
disguise.detailZh: 如果此宝可梦处于化形的样子并受到招式伤害，它会变为现形的样子，且该伤害会被防止。其他效果不会被防止。此特性无法被复制或替换。此特性仅对谜拟丘生效。
disguise.detailPt: Se este Pokémon estiver em sua Forma Disfarçada e sofrer dano de um movimento, ele muda para sua Forma Revelada e o dano é prevenido. Outros efeitos não são prevenidos. Esta habilidade não pode ser copiada ou substituída. Esta habilidade só tem efeito para Mimikyu.

electric-surge.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.
electric-surge.textEs: Crea un campo eléctrico al entrar en combate.
electric-surge.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.
electric-surge.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, cambia el terreno a Campo Eléctrico.
electric-surge.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场时，将场地变为电气场地。
electric-surge.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha, ele muda o terreno para Electric Terrain.

psychic-surge.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.
psychic-surge.textEs: Crea un campo psíquico al entrar en combate.
psychic-surge.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.
psychic-surge.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, cambia el terreno a Campo Psíquico.
psychic-surge.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场时，将场地变为精神场地。
psychic-surge.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha, ele muda o terreno para Psychic Terrain.

grassy-surge.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
grassy-surge.textEs: Crea un campo de hierba al entrar en combate.
grassy-surge.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
grassy-surge.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, cambia el terreno a Campo de Hierba.
grassy-surge.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场时，将场地变为青草场地。
grassy-surge.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha, ele muda o terreno para Grassy Terrain.

misty-surge.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Misty Terrain.
misty-surge.textEs: Crea un campo de niebla al entrar en combate.
misty-surge.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Misty Terrain.
misty-surge.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, cambia el terreno a Campo de Niebla.
misty-surge.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场时，将场地变为薄雾场地。
misty-surge.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha, ele muda o terreno para Misty Terrain.

full-metal-body.textEn: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
full-metal-body.textEs: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
full-metal-body.detail: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
full-metal-body.detailEs: Las características de este Pokémon no pueden ser reducidas por los movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon. Este efecto solo se aplica a las modificaciones de características normales y no a efectos más exóticos como Reversión o Cambiafuerza. Esta habilidad no es ignorada por Rompemoldes, Terravoltaje ni Turbollama.
full-metal-body.detailZh: 此宝可梦的能力不会被其他宝可梦的招式或特性降低。此效果只适用于普通的能力等级变化，不适用于颠倒或力量互换等更特殊的效果。此特性不会被破格、兆级电压或涡轮火焰无视。
full-metal-body.detailPt: Os atributos deste Pokémon não podem ser diminuídos por movimentos ou habilidades de outros Pokémon. Este efeito se aplica apenas a modificações normais de atributos e não a efeitos mais exóticos como Topsy-Turvy ou Power Swap. Esta Habilidade não é ignorada por Mold Breaker, Teravolt ou Turboblaze.

shadow-shield.textEn: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
shadow-shield.textEs: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
shadow-shield.detail: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
shadow-shield.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon tiene los PS al máximo, el daño normal (¡no el daño fijo!) de los movimientos se reduce a la mitad. Esta habilidad no puede ser anulada.
shadow-shield.detailZh: 当此宝可梦HP全满时，来自招式的常规伤害（不包括固定伤害！）减半。此特性无法被无效化。
shadow-shield.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem o HP cheio, o dano normal (não o dano fixo!) de movimentos é reduzido pela metade. Esta habilidade não pode ser anulada.

beast-boost.textEn: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
beast-boost.textEs: Si derrota a un rival en ese turno, aumenta su característica más fuerte.
beast-boost.detail: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.
beast-boost.detailEs: Aumenta en un nivel la característica más alta de este Pokémon cuando debilita a otro Pokémon.
beast-boost.detailZh: 当此宝可梦使其他宝可梦濒死时，其数值最高的能力提升一个等级。
beast-boost.detailPt: Aumenta o atributo mais alto deste Pokémon em um estágio quando ele nocauteia outro Pokémon.

prism-armor.textEn: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
prism-armor.textEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
prism-armor.detail: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
prism-armor.detailEs: El daño supereficaz que recibe este Pokémon se reduce a 0.75×. Esta habilidad no es ignorada por Rompemoldes, Terravoltaje ni Turbollama.
prism-armor.detailZh: 此宝可梦受到的效果绝佳伤害降低至0.75×。此特性不会被破格、兆级电压或涡轮火焰无视。
prism-armor.detailPt: O dano supereficaz que este Pokémon sofre é reduzido para 0.75×. Esta Habilidade não é ignorada por Mold Breaker, Teravolt ou Turboblaze.

soul-heart.textEn: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokemon faints.
soul-heart.textEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial cada vez que un Pokémon cae debilitado.
soul-heart.detail: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokemon faints.
soul-heart.detailEs: El Ataque Especial de este Pokémon aumenta un nivel cada vez que cualquier Pokémon se debilita.
soul-heart.detailZh: 每当有任何宝可梦濒死时，此宝可梦的特攻提升一个等级。
soul-heart.detailPt: O Ataque Especial deste Pokémon sobe um estágio toda vez que qualquer Pokémon é nocauteado.

libero.textEn: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
libero.textEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
libero.detail: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
libero.detailEs: Cambia el tipo del Pokémon al tipo del movimiento que está a punto de usar. Esto solo funciona una vez cada vez que el Pokémon entra en combate.
libero.detailZh: 将此宝可梦的属性变为其即将使用的招式的属性。此效果在宝可梦每次出场后只能生效一次。
libero.detailPt: Muda o tipo do Pokémon para o tipo do movimento que ele está prestes a usar. Isso funciona apenas uma vez a cada vez que o Pokémon entra em batalha.

mirror-armor.textEn: If this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered, the attacker's are lowered instead.
mirror-armor.textEs: Refleja los efectos que reducen las características.
mirror-armor.detail: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.
mirror-armor.detailEs: Devuelve al atacante únicamente los efectos que reducirían las características de este Pokémon.
mirror-armor.detailZh: 只将此宝可梦受到的降低能力的效果反弹回去。
mirror-armor.detailPt: Reflete de volta apenas os efeitos de diminuição de atributos que o Pokémon recebe.

cotton-down.textEn: If this Pokemon is hit, it lowers the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field 1 stage.
cotton-down.textEs: Al ser alcanzado por un ataque, suelta una pelusa de algodón que reduce la Velocidad de todos los demás Pokémon.
cotton-down.detail: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field is lowered by 1 stage.
cotton-down.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon es golpeado por un ataque, esparce pelusa de algodón a su alrededor y reduce la Velocidad de todos los Pokémon excepto él mismo.
cotton-down.detailZh: 当此宝可梦受到攻击击中时，会向四周散布棉絮，使除自己以外所有宝可梦的速度降低。
cotton-down.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon é atingido por um ataque, ele espalha penugem de algodão ao redor e diminui a Velocidade de todos os Pokémon, exceto ele mesmo.

ball-fetch.textEs: Si no lleva equipado ningún objeto, recupera la Poké Ball del primer intento de captura fallido.
ball-fetch.detailEs: En cualquier momento después de que se lance la primera Poké Ball y esta falle al capturar a un Pokémon, al final de un turno, si un Pokémon con Recogebolas está en el campo y no lleva otro objeto, recogerá una bola del mismo tipo que la primera lanzada.
ball-fetch.detailZh: 在第一个精灵球被投出且未能捉到宝可梦之后的任意时刻，在回合结束时，如果拥有捡球特性的宝可梦在场且没有携带其他物品，它会捡回与第一个投出的球相同种类的球。
ball-fetch.detailPt: A qualquer momento após a primeira Poké Ball ser lançada e falhar em capturar um Pokémon, ao final de um turno, se um Pokémon com Ball Fetch estiver em campo e não estiver segurando outro item, ele pegará o mesmo tipo de bola que a primeira lançada.

steam-engine.textEn: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by Fire/Water moves.
steam-engine.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego o Agua, le sube muchísimo la Velocidad.
steam-engine.detail: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by a Fire- or Water-type move.
steam-engine.detailEs: Aumenta la Velocidad del usuario en tres niveles cuando es golpeado por un ataque de tipo Fuego o Agua. El ataque sigue infligiendo daño.
steam-engine.detailZh: 当此宝可梦被火属性或水属性攻击击中时，其速度提升三个等级。该攻击仍会造成伤害。
steam-engine.detailPt: Aumenta a Velocidade do usuário em três estágios quando ele é atingido por um ataque do tipo Fogo ou Água. O ataque ainda causa dano.

ripen.textEn: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled.
ripen.textEs: Hace madurar las bayas, por lo que duplica sus efectos.
ripen.detail: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
ripen.detailEs: Madura las bayas y duplica su efecto.
ripen.detailZh: 使树果成熟，其效果变为两倍。
ripen.detailPt: Amadurece as Berries e dobra seu efeito.

punk-rock.textEn: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from sound moves. Its own have 1.3x power.
punk-rock.textEs: Potencia los movimientos que usan sonido y reduce a la mitad el daño que le infligen dichos movimientos.
punk-rock.detail: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.
punk-rock.detailEs: Potencia los movimientos basados en sonido. Además, este Pokémon recibe la mitad de daño de ese tipo de movimientos.
punk-rock.detailZh: 提升声音类招式的威力。此宝可梦受到此类招式的伤害也会减半。
punk-rock.detailPt: Aumenta o poder de movimentos baseados em som. O Pokémon também sofre metade do dano desses tipos de movimentos.

steely-spirit.textEn: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
steely-spirit.textEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero de los aliados.
steely-spirit.detail: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. This affects Doom Desire even if the user is not on the field.
steely-spirit.detailEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero del Pokémon y de sus aliados.
steely-spirit.detailZh: 提升此宝可梦及其同伴的钢属性招式的威力。
steely-spirit.detailPt: Fortalece os movimentos do tipo Aço do Pokémon e de seus aliados.

perish-body.textEn: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker.
perish-body.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, se debilitará al cabo de 3 turnos, así como su agresor, a menos que abandonen el terreno de combate.
perish-body.detail: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker. This effect does not happen for this Pokemon if the attacker already has a perish count.
perish-body.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon con Cuerpo Mortal es golpeado por un movimiento de contacto, tanto el atacante como el Pokémon con Cuerpo Mortal se debilitarán en tres turnos.
perish-body.detailZh: 当拥有灭亡之躯特性的宝可梦被接触类招式击中时，攻击方和拥有灭亡之躯的宝可梦都会在三回合后濒死。
perish-body.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon com Perish Body é atingido por um movimento de contato, tanto o atacante quanto o Pokémon com Perish Body serão nocauteados em três turnos.

ice-scales.textEn: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from special attacks.
ice-scales.textEs: Las gélidas escamas que protegen su cuerpo reducen a la mitad el daño que le infligen los ataques especiales.
ice-scales.detail: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from special attacks.
ice-scales.detailEs: El Pokémon está protegido por escamas de hielo, que reducen a la mitad el daño recibido de los movimientos especiales.
ice-scales.detailZh: 此宝可梦受到冰鳞粉的保护，受到的特殊招式伤害减半。
ice-scales.detailPt: O Pokémon é protegido por escamas de gelo, que reduzem pela metade o dano sofrido de movimentos especiais.

power-spot.textEn: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3.
power-spot.textEs: Potencia los movimientos de los Pokémon adyacentes.
power-spot.detail: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3. This affects Doom Desire and Future Sight, even if the user is not on the field.
power-spot.detailEs: La potencia de los movimientos usados por los aliados del Pokémon con Fuente Energía aumenta un 30%.
power-spot.detailZh: 拥有能量点特性的宝可梦的同伴所使用招式的威力提升30%。
power-spot.detailPt: O poder dos movimentos usados pelos aliados do Pokémon com Power Spot é aumentado em 30%.

ice-face.textEn: If Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes deals 0 damage. Effect is restored in Snow.
ice-face.textEs: Absorbe el daño de un ataque físico con el hielo de la cabeza, tras lo cual cambia de forma. El hielo se regenerará la próxima vez que granice.
ice-face.detail: If this Pokemon is an Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its ice face is then broken and it changes forme to Noice Face. Eiscue regains its Ice Face forme when Snow begins or when Eiscue switches in while Snow is active. Confusion damage also breaks the ice face.
ice-face.detailEs: Cuando un Eiscue en su Cara de Hielo es golpeado por un movimiento físico, no recibe daño y cambia a su Cara Deshielo. Si comienza una granizada o una nevada mientras Eiscue está en su Cara Deshielo, o si entra en combate en su Cara Deshielo durante el granizo, volverá inmediatamente a su Cara de Hielo.
ice-face.detailZh: 当处于结冻头形态的冰砌鹅被物理招式击中时，它不会受到伤害，并变为解冻头形态。如果冰砌鹅处于解冻头形态时下起冰雹或下雪，或在冰雹天气下以解冻头形态出场，它会立即恢复为结冻头形态。
ice-face.detailPt: Quando um Eiscue em sua forma Cara de Gelo é atingido por um movimento físico, ele não sofre dano e muda para sua forma Cara Derretida. Se uma tempestade de granizo ou de neve começar enquanto Eiscue estiver em sua forma Cara Derretida, ou se ele for enviado em sua forma Cara Derretida durante o granizo, ele reverterá imediatamente para sua forma Cara de Gelo.

hunger-switch.textEn: If Morpeko, it changes between Full Belly and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.
hunger-switch.textEs: Alterna entre su Forma Saciada y Forma Voraz al final de cada turno.
hunger-switch.detail: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.
hunger-switch.detailEs: El Pokémon cambia de forma, alternando entre su Forma Saciada y su Forma Voraz al final de cada turno.
hunger-switch.detailZh: 此宝可梦在每回合结束后改变形态，在满腹花纹和空腹花纹之间交替。
hunger-switch.detailPt: O Pokémon muda de forma, alternando entre seu Modo Barriga Cheia e Modo Esfomeado ao final de cada turno.

intrepid-sword.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
intrepid-sword.textEs: Aumenta su Ataque al entrar en combate.
intrepid-sword.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
intrepid-sword.detailEs: Aumenta el Ataque del Pokémon la primera vez que entra en combate.
intrepid-sword.detailZh: 此宝可梦首次出场时，攻击提升。
intrepid-sword.detailPt: Aumenta o Ataque do Pokémon na primeira vez que ele entra em batalha.

dauntless-shield.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
dauntless-shield.textEs: Aumenta su Defensa al entrar en combate.
dauntless-shield.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
dauntless-shield.detailEs: Aumenta la Defensa del Pokémon la primera vez que entra en combate.
dauntless-shield.detailZh: 此宝可梦首次出场时，防御提升。
dauntless-shield.detailPt: Aumenta a Defesa do Pokémon na primeira vez que ele entra em batalha.

unseen-fist.textEn: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
unseen-fist.textEs: Si usa un movimiento de contacto, puede infligir daño al objetivo aunque este se proteja.
unseen-fist.detail: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
unseen-fist.detailEs: Si el Pokémon usa movimientos que hacen contacto directo, puede atacar al objetivo aunque este se esté protegiendo.
unseen-fist.detailZh: 如果此宝可梦使用直接接触的招式，即使目标正在保护自己，也能进行攻击。
unseen-fist.detailPt: Se o Pokémon usar movimentos que fazem contato direto, ele pode atacar o alvo mesmo que o alvo esteja se protegendo.

transistor.textEn: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.
transistor.textEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.
transistor.detail: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.
transistor.detailEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico usados por este Pokémon en un 50%.
transistor.detailZh: 使此宝可梦使用的电属性招式威力提升50%。
transistor.detailPt: Aumenta o poder dos movimentos do tipo Elétrico usados por este Pokémon em 50%.

dragons-maw.textEn: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.
dragons-maw.textEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón.
dragons-maw.detail: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.
dragons-maw.detailEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de tipo Dragón usados por este Pokémon en un 50%.
dragons-maw.detailZh: 使此宝可梦使用的龙属性招式威力提升50%。
dragons-maw.detailPt: Aumenta o poder dos movimentos do tipo Dragão usados por este Pokémon em 50%.

chilling-neigh.textEn: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
chilling-neigh.textEs: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho gélido y aumenta su Ataque.
chilling-neigh.detail: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
chilling-neigh.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon debilita a un objetivo, emite un relincho escalofriante que aumenta su Ataque.
chilling-neigh.detailZh: 当此宝可梦击倒目标时，会发出冰冷的嘶鸣，提升自己的攻击。
chilling-neigh.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon nocauteia um alvo, ele emite um relincho arrepiante, que aumenta seu Ataque.

grim-neigh.textEn: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
grim-neigh.textEs: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho aterrador y aumenta su Ataque Especial.
grim-neigh.detail: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
grim-neigh.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon debilita a un objetivo, emite un relincho aterrador que aumenta su Ataque Especial.
grim-neigh.detailZh: 当此宝可梦击倒目标时，会发出可怕的嘶鸣，提升自己的特攻。
grim-neigh.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon nocauteia um alvo, ele emite um relincho aterrorizante, que aumenta seu Ataque Especial.

lingering-aroma.textEn: Making contact with this Pokemon has the attacker's Ability become Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.textEs: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.detail: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Lingering Aroma. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Lingering Aroma, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
lingering-aroma.detailEs: El contacto con el Pokémon cambia la habilidad del atacante a Olor Persistente.
lingering-aroma.detailZh: 与此宝可梦发生接触后，攻击方的特性会变为甩不掉的气味。
lingering-aroma.detailPt: O contato com o Pokémon muda a Habilidade do atacante para Lingering Aroma.

well-baked-body.textEn: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.
well-baked-body.textEs: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
well-baked-body.detail: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves and raises its Defense by 2 stages when hit by a Fire-type move.
well-baked-body.detailEs: El Pokémon no recibe daño cuando es golpeado por movimientos de tipo Fuego. En su lugar, su Defensa aumenta mucho.
well-baked-body.detailZh: 此宝可梦被火属性招式击中时不会受到伤害，其防御反而会大幅提升。
well-baked-body.detailPt: O Pokémon não sofre dano quando atingido por movimentos do tipo Fogo. Em vez disso, sua Defesa é bruscamente aumentada.

seed-sower.textEn: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.
seed-sower.textEs: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
seed-sower.detail: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.
seed-sower.detailEs: Convierte el terreno en Campo de Hierba cuando el Pokémon es golpeado por un ataque.
seed-sower.detailZh: 当此宝可梦受到攻击击中时，会将地面变为青草场地。
seed-sower.detailPt: Transforma o chão em Grassy Terrain quando o Pokémon é atingido por um ataque.

electromorphosis.textEn: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.
electromorphosis.textEs: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
electromorphosis.detail: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.
electromorphosis.detailEs: El Pokémon se carga de electricidad cuando recibe daño, lo que potencia el siguiente movimiento de tipo Eléctrico que use.
electromorphosis.detailZh: 此宝可梦受到伤害时会进入充电状态，提升其接下来使用的下一个电属性招式的威力。
electromorphosis.detailPt: O Pokémon fica carregado quando sofre dano, aumentando o poder do próximo movimento do tipo Elétrico que o Pokémon usar.

guard-dog.textEn: Immune to Intimidate. Intimidated: +1 Attack. Cannot be forced to switch out.
guard-dog.textEs: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
guard-dog.detail: This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability and raises its Attack by 1 stage instead. This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
guard-dog.detailEs: Aumenta el Ataque del Pokémon si es intimidado. Además, los movimientos y objetos que obligarían al Pokémon a ser cambiado no surten efecto.
guard-dog.detailZh: 受到威吓时，此宝可梦的攻击提升。会强制此宝可梦换下场的招式和道具也会失效。
guard-dog.detailPt: Aumenta o Ataque do Pokémon se ele for intimidado. Movimentos e itens que forçariam o Pokémon a ser trocado também falham.

anger-shell.textEn: At 1/2 or less of this Pokemon's max HP: +1 Atk, Sp. Atk, Spe, and -1 Def, Sp. Def.
anger-shell.textEs: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
anger-shell.detail: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage, and its Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
anger-shell.detailEs: Cuando un ataque hace que sus PS bajen a la mitad o menos, el Pokémon se enfurece. Esto reduce su Defensa y su Defensa Especial, pero aumenta su Ataque, su Ataque Especial y su Velocidad.
anger-shell.detailZh: 当攻击使其HP降至一半或以下时，此宝可梦会被激怒，使其防御和特防降低，但攻击、特攻和速度提升。
anger-shell.detailPt: Quando um ataque faz seu HP cair para a metade ou menos, o Pokémon fica com raiva. Isso diminui sua Defesa e Defesa Especial, mas aumenta seu Ataque, Ataque Especial e Velocidade.

opportunist.textEn: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
opportunist.textEs: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
opportunist.detail: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
opportunist.detailEs: Si una característica del rival aumenta, el Pokémon aprovecha la oportunidad para aumentar esa misma característica.
opportunist.detailZh: 当对手的能力提升时，此宝可梦会趁机将自己的相同能力也提升。
opportunist.detailPt: Se um atributo de um oponente for aumentado, o Pokémon aproveita a oportunidade para aumentar o mesmo atributo para si.

rocky-payload.textEn: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Rock-type attack.
rocky-payload.detail: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Rock-type attack.
rocky-payload.detailEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de tipo Roca usados por este Pokémon en un 50%.
rocky-payload.detailZh: 使此宝可梦使用的岩石属性招式威力提升50%。
rocky-payload.detailPt: Aumenta o poder dos movimentos do tipo Pedra usados por este Pokémon em 50%.

zero-to-hero.textEn: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
zero-to-hero.textEs: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
zero-to-hero.detail: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
zero-to-hero.detailEs: El Pokémon se transforma en su Forma Heroica cuando se retira del combate.
zero-to-hero.detailZh: 此宝可梦在退场换下时变为全能形态。
zero-to-hero.detailPt: O Pokémon se transforma em sua Forma Heroica quando é trocado.

earth-eater.textEn: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.
earth-eater.textEs: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
earth-eater.detail: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Ground-type move.
earth-eater.detailEs: Si es golpeado por un movimiento de tipo Tierra, el Pokémon recupera PS en lugar de recibir daño.
earth-eater.detailZh: 被地面属性招式击中时，此宝可梦不会受到伤害，而是回复HP。
earth-eater.detailPt: Se for atingido por um movimento do tipo Terrestre, o Pokémon tem seu HP restaurado em vez de sofrer dano.

costar.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies all of its ally's stat stage changes.
costar.textEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
costar.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies all of its ally's stat stage changes.
costar.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon entra en combate, copia los cambios de características de un aliado.
costar.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，会复制同伴的能力变化。
costar.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon entra em batalha, ele copia as mudanças de atributos de um aliado.

armor-tail.textEn: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
armor-tail.textEs: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
armor-tail.detail: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
armor-tail.detailEs: La misteriosa cola que cubre la cabeza del Pokémon impide que los rivales usen movimientos con prioridad contra el Pokémon o sus aliados.
armor-tail.detailZh: 覆盖在此宝可梦头部的神秘尾巴使对手无法对此宝可梦或其同伴使用先制招式。
armor-tail.detailPt: A cauda misteriosa que cobre a cabeça do Pokémon impede os oponentes de usar movimentos de prioridade contra o Pokémon ou seus aliados.

supreme-overlord.textEn: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.
supreme-overlord.textEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
supreme-overlord.detail: This Pokemon's moves have their power multiplied by 1+(X*0.1), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side when this Ability became active, and X cannot be greater than 5.
supreme-overlord.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon entra en combate, su Ataque y su Ataque Especial aumentan ligeramente por cada aliado de su equipo que ya haya sido derrotado.
supreme-overlord.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，队伍中每有一只已被击倒的同伴，其攻击和特攻就会小幅提升。
supreme-overlord.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon entra em batalha, seu Ataque e Ataque Especial são levemente aumentados para cada um dos aliados de sua equipe que já foram derrotados.

protosynthesis.textEn: Sunny Day active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3x, or 1.5x if Speed.
protosynthesis.textEs: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
protosynthesis.detail: If Sunny Day is active or this Pokemon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokemon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Sunny Day, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Sunny Day is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokemon is no longer active.
protosynthesis.detailEs: Aumenta la característica más alta del Pokémon cuando hace sol o si lleva Energía Potenciadora.
protosynthesis.detailZh: 在日照强烈时或此宝可梦携带驱劲能量时，提升其数值最高的能力。
protosynthesis.detailPt: Aumenta o atributo mais proficiente do Pokémon sob sol forte ou se o Pokémon estiver segurando uma Booster Energy.

quark-drive.textEn: Electric Terrain active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3x, or 1.5x if Speed.
quark-drive.textEs: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.detail: If Electric Terrain is active or this Pokemon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokemon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Electric Terrain, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Electric Terrain is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokemon is no longer active.
quark-drive.detailEs: Aumenta la característica más alta del Pokémon en el Campo Eléctrico o si lleva Energía Potenciadora.
quark-drive.detailZh: 在电气场地上或此宝可梦携带驱劲能量时，提升其数值最高的能力。
quark-drive.detailPt: Aumenta o atributo mais proficiente do Pokémon no Electric Terrain ou se o Pokémon estiver segurando uma Booster Energy.

good-as-gold.textEn: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.
good-as-gold.textEs: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.
good-as-gold.detail: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.
good-as-gold.detailEs: Su cuerpo de oro puro y macizo otorga al Pokémon inmunidad total frente a los movimientos de estado de otros Pokémon.
good-as-gold.detailZh: 纯金打造的坚实身体使此宝可梦完全不受其他宝可梦变化招式的影响。
good-as-gold.detailPt: Um corpo de ouro puro e maciço dá ao Pokémon imunidade total aos movimentos de status de outros Pokémon.

tablets-of-ruin.textEn: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.
tablets-of-ruin.textEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
tablets-of-ruin.detail: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.
tablets-of-ruin.detailEs: El poder de las ruinosas tablillas de madera del Pokémon reduce el Ataque de todos los Pokémon excepto el suyo.
tablets-of-ruin.detailZh: 此宝可梦灾祸之简的力量会降低除自己以外所有宝可梦的攻击。
tablets-of-ruin.detailPt: O poder das tábuas de madeira ruinosas do Pokémon diminui o Ataque de todos os Pokémon, exceto ele mesmo.

sword-of-ruin.textEn: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.
sword-of-ruin.textEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
sword-of-ruin.detail: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.
sword-of-ruin.detailEs: El poder de la ruinosa espada del Pokémon reduce la Defensa de todos los Pokémon excepto la suya.
sword-of-ruin.detailZh: 此宝可梦灾祸之剑的力量会降低除自己以外所有宝可梦的防御。
sword-of-ruin.detailPt: O poder da espada ruinosa do Pokémon diminui a Defesa de todos os Pokémon, exceto ele mesmo.

vessel-of-ruin.textEn: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.
vessel-of-ruin.textEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
vessel-of-ruin.detail: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.
vessel-of-ruin.detailEs: El poder de la ruinosa vasija del Pokémon reduce el Ataque Especial de todos los Pokémon excepto el suyo.
vessel-of-ruin.detailZh: 此宝可梦灾祸之器的力量会降低除自己以外所有宝可梦的特攻。
vessel-of-ruin.detailPt: O poder do recipiente ruinoso do Pokémon diminui o Ataque Especial de todos os Pokémon, exceto ele mesmo.

beads-of-ruin.textEn: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Defense multiplied by 0.75.
beads-of-ruin.textEs: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
beads-of-ruin.detail: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Defense multiplied by 0.75.
beads-of-ruin.detailEs: El poder de las ruinosas cuentas del Pokémon reduce la Defensa Especial de todos los Pokémon excepto la suya.
beads-of-ruin.detailZh: 此宝可梦灾祸之玉的力量会降低除自己以外所有宝可梦的特防。
beads-of-ruin.detailPt: O poder das contas ruinosas do Pokémon diminui a Defesa Especial de todos os Pokémon, exceto ele mesmo.

orichalcum-pulse.textEn: On switch-in, summons Sunny Day. During Sunny Day, Attack is 1.3333x.
orichalcum-pulse.textEs: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
orichalcum-pulse.detail: On switch-in, summons Sunny Day. During Sunny Day, Attack is 1.3333x.
orichalcum-pulse.detailEs: Hace que el sol brille con intensidad cuando el Pokémon entra en combate. El pulso ancestral que late en su interior también aumenta su Ataque cuando hace sol.
orichalcum-pulse.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，使日照变得强烈。此外，回荡在此宝可梦体内的古代脉动会在日照强烈时提升其攻击。
orichalcum-pulse.detailPt: Torna a luz do sol forte quando o Pokémon entra em batalha. O pulso ancestral que percorre o Pokémon também aumenta seu Ataque sob sol forte.

hadron-engine.textEn: On switch-in, summons Electric Terrain. During Electric Terrain, Sp. Atk is 1.3333x.
hadron-engine.textEs: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
hadron-engine.detail: On switch-in, summons Electric Terrain. During Electric Terrain, Sp. Atk is 1.3333x.
hadron-engine.detailEs: Convierte el terreno en Campo Eléctrico cuando el Pokémon entra en combate. El motor futurista que alberga en su interior también aumenta su Ataque Especial en el Campo Eléctrico.
hadron-engine.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，将地面变为电气场地。此外，此宝可梦体内的未来引擎会在电气场地上提升其特攻。
hadron-engine.detailPt: Transforma o chão em Electric Terrain quando o Pokémon entra em batalha. O motor futurístico dentro do Pokémon também aumenta seu Ataque Especial no Electric Terrain.

supersweet-syrup.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
supersweet-syrup.textEs: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
supersweet-syrup.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
supersweet-syrup.detailEs: Un aroma empalagosamente dulce se extiende por el campo la primera vez que el Pokémon entra en combate, lo que reduce la Evasión de los Pokémon rivales.
supersweet-syrup.detailZh: 此宝可梦首次出场时，甜腻的香气会扩散到整个场地，降低对手宝可梦的闪避率。
supersweet-syrup.detailPt: Um aroma enjoativamente doce se espalha pelo campo na primeira vez que o Pokémon entra em batalha, diminuindo a Evasão dos Pokémon adversários.

hospitality.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.
hospitality.textEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP
hospitality.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.
hospitality.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon entra en combate, colma de atenciones a su aliado y le restaura una pequeña cantidad de PS.
hospitality.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，会盛情款待同伴，回复同伴的少量HP。
hospitality.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon entra em batalha, ele recebe seu aliado com hospitalidade, restaurando uma pequena quantidade do HP do aliado.

toxic-chain.textEn: This Pokemon's moves have a 30% chance of badly poisoning.
toxic-chain.textEs: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
toxic-chain.detail: This Pokemon's moves have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
toxic-chain.detailEs: El poder de la cadena tóxica del Pokémon puede envenenar gravemente a cualquier objetivo que golpee con un movimiento.
toxic-chain.detailZh: 凭借毒锁链的力量，此宝可梦用招式击中目标时，有时会使目标陷入剧毒状态。
toxic-chain.detailPt: O poder da corrente tóxica do Pokémon pode envenenar gravemente qualquer alvo que o Pokémon atingir com um movimento.

tera-shift.textEn: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.
tera-shift.textEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
tera-shift.detail: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.
tera-shift.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon entra en combate, absorbe la energía de su alrededor y se transforma en su Forma Teracristal.
tera-shift.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，会吸收周围的能量，变为太晶形态。
tera-shift.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon entra em batalha, ele absorve a energia ao seu redor e se transforma em sua Forma Terastal.

poison-puppeteer.textEn: Pecharunt: If this Pokemon poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
poison-puppeteer.textEs: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
poison-puppeteer.detail: If this Pokemon is a Pecharunt and poisons or badly poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
poison-puppeteer.detailEs: Cuando un Pokémon resulta envenenado por cualquiera de los movimientos de Pecharunt, también será confundido.
poison-puppeteer.detailZh: 因桃歹郎的招式而陷入中毒状态的宝可梦，同时也会陷入混乱状态。
poison-puppeteer.detailPt: Quando um Pokémon é envenenado por qualquer um dos movimentos de Pecharunt, ele também ficará confuso.

parental-bond.textEn: This Pokemon's damaging moves hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered.
parental-bond.textEs: Une fuerzas con su cría y ataca dos veces.
parental-bond.detail: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.
parental-bond.detailEs: Permite al portador golpear dos veces con los movimientos de daño. El segundo golpe tiene la mitad de potencia.
parental-bond.detailZh: 使持有者的伤害招式可以攻击两次。第二次攻击的威力减半。
parental-bond.detailPt: Permite que o portador acerte duas vezes com movimentos de dano. O segundo golpe tem metade do poder.

aerilate.textEn: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying type and have 1.2x power.
aerilate.textEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Volador y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
aerilate.detail: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
aerilate.detailEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal del portador en movimientos de tipo Volador. Los movimientos modificados por esta habilidad tienen 1.3× su potencia.
aerilate.detailZh: 将持有者的一般属性招式变为飞行属性招式。被此特性改变的招式威力变为1.3×。
aerilate.detailPt: Transforma os movimentos do tipo Normal do portador em movimentos do tipo Voador. Movimentos alterados por esta habilidade têm 1.3× seu poder.

primordial-sea.textEn: On switch-in, heavy rain begins until this Ability is not active in battle.
primordial-sea.textEs: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Fuego.
primordial-sea.detail: On switch-in, the weather becomes Primordial Sea, which includes all the effects of Rain Dance and prevents damaging Fire-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Desolate Land Abilities.
primordial-sea.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate u obtiene esta habilidad, el clima se convierte en lluvia torrencial. La lluvia torrencial tiene todas las propiedades de Danza Lluvia y además hace que los movimientos de tipo Fuego que infligen daño fallen. La lluvia torrencial termina cuando este Pokémon abandona el combate o pierde esta habilidad, o cuando esta habilidad es anulada. El clima no puede cambiarse de otra manera, salvo por los efectos de Ráfaga Delta y Tierra del Ocaso. Esclusa de Aire y Aclimatación impedirán los efectos de la lluvia torrencial, incluyendo permitir que los movimientos de tipo Fuego funcionen, pero no permitirán cambiar el clima.
primordial-sea.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场或获得此特性时，天气变为大雨。大雨具有求雨的所有效果，并且会使造成伤害的火属性招式失败。当此宝可梦离场、失去此特性或此特性被无效化时，大雨结束。除德尔塔气流和终结之地的效果外，该天气无法被其他方式改变。气闸和无关天气会阻止大雨的效果（包括允许火属性招式正常生效），但不会使天气被改变。
primordial-sea.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha ou ganha esta habilidade, o clima se torna chuva intensa. A chuva intensa tem todas as propriedades de Rain Dance e também faz com que movimentos de dano do tipo Fogo falhem. A chuva intensa termina quando este Pokémon sai de batalha ou perde esta habilidade, ou quando esta habilidade é anulada. O clima não pode ser alterado de outra forma, exceto pelos efeitos de Delta Stream e Desolate Land. Air Lock e Cloud Nine impedirão os efeitos da chuva intensa, inclusive permitindo que movimentos do tipo Fogo funcionem, mas não permitirão que o clima seja alterado.

desolate-land.textEn: On switch-in, extremely harsh sunlight begins until this Ability is not active in battle.
desolate-land.textEs: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Agua.
desolate-land.detail: On switch-in, the weather becomes Desolate Land, which includes all the effects of Sunny Day and prevents damaging Water-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Primordial Sea Abilities.
desolate-land.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate u obtiene esta habilidad, el clima se convierte en sol abrasador. El sol abrasador tiene todas las propiedades de Día Soleado y además hace que los movimientos de tipo Agua que infligen daño fallen. El sol abrasador termina cuando este Pokémon abandona el combate o pierde esta habilidad, o cuando esta habilidad es anulada. El clima no puede cambiarse de otra manera, salvo por los efectos de Ráfaga Delta y Mar del Albor. Esclusa de Aire y Aclimatación impedirán los efectos del sol abrasador, incluyendo permitir que los movimientos de tipo Agua funcionen, pero no permitirán cambiar el clima.
desolate-land.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场或获得此特性时，天气变为大日照。大日照具有大晴天的所有效果，并且会使造成伤害的水属性招式失败。当此宝可梦离场、失去此特性或此特性被无效化时，大日照结束。除德尔塔气流和始源之海的效果外，该天气无法被其他方式改变。气闸和无关天气会阻止大日照的效果（包括允许水属性招式正常生效），但不会使天气被改变。
desolate-land.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha ou ganha esta habilidade, o clima se torna sol extremamente forte. O sol extremamente forte tem todas as propriedades de Sunny Day e também faz com que movimentos de dano do tipo Água falhem. O sol extremamente forte termina quando este Pokémon sai de batalha ou perde esta habilidade, ou quando esta habilidade é anulada. O clima não pode ser alterado de outra forma, exceto pelos efeitos de Delta Stream e Primordial Sea. Air Lock e Cloud Nine impedirão os efeitos do sol extremamente forte, inclusive permitindo que movimentos do tipo Água funcionem, mas não permitirão que o clima seja alterado.

delta-stream.textEn: On switch-in, strong winds begin until this Ability is not active in battle.
delta-stream.textEs: Altera el clima para anular las vulnerabilidades del tipo Volador.
delta-stream.detail: On switch-in, the weather becomes Delta Stream, which removes the weaknesses of the Flying type from Flying-type Pokemon. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Desolate Land or Primordial Sea Abilities.
delta-stream.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate u obtiene esta habilidad, el clima se convierte en turbulencias misteriosas. Las turbulencias misteriosas hacen que los movimientos no sean supereficaces contra el tipo Volador; en su lugar infligen daño neutro. Anticipación y Trampa Rocas no se ven afectados. Las turbulencias misteriosas terminan cuando este Pokémon abandona el combate o pierde esta habilidad, o cuando esta habilidad es anulada. El clima no puede cambiarse de otra manera, salvo por los efectos de Tierra del Ocaso y Mar del Albor. Esclusa de Aire y Aclimatación impedirán el efecto de las turbulencias misteriosas, pero no permitirán cambiar el clima.
delta-stream.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场或获得此特性时，天气变为神秘的乱流。乱流会使招式对飞行属性不再效果绝佳，而是造成普通效果的伤害。危险预知和隐形岩不受影响。当此宝可梦离场、失去此特性或此特性被无效化时，乱流结束。除终结之地和始源之海的效果外，该天气无法被其他方式改变。气闸和无关天气会阻止乱流的效果，但不会使天气被改变。
delta-stream.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha ou ganha esta habilidade, o clima se torna uma corrente de ar misteriosa. Uma corrente de ar misteriosa faz com que movimentos não sejam supereficazes contra o tipo Voador; eles causam dano neutro em vez disso. Anticipation e Stealth Rock não são afetados. A corrente de ar misteriosa termina quando este Pokémon sai de batalha ou perde esta habilidade, ou quando esta habilidade é anulada. O clima não pode ser alterado de outra forma, exceto pelos efeitos de Desolate Land e Primordial Sea. Air Lock e Cloud Nine impedirão o efeito de uma corrente de ar misteriosa, mas não permitirão que o clima seja alterado.

surge-surfer.textEn: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
surge-surfer.textEs: Duplica su Velocidad si hay un campo eléctrico en el terreno de combate.
surge-surfer.detail: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
surge-surfer.detailEs: Duplica la Velocidad de este Pokémon en el Campo Eléctrico.
surge-surfer.detailZh: 在电气场地上，此宝可梦的速度变为两倍。
surge-surfer.detailPt: Dobra a Velocidade deste Pokémon no Electric Terrain.

power-of-alchemy.textEn: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.
power-of-alchemy.textEs: Reacciona copiando la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
power-of-alchemy.detail: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
power-of-alchemy.detailEs: Cuando un aliado se debilita, este Pokémon obtiene su habilidad.
power-of-alchemy.detailZh: 当同伴濒死时，此宝可梦获得其特性。
power-of-alchemy.detailPt: Quando um aliado é nocauteado, este Pokémon ganha a Habilidade dele.

battle-bond.textEn: After KOing a Pokemon: raises Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed by 1 stage. Once per battle.
battle-bond.textEs: Al derrotar a un rival, los vínculos con su Entrenador se refuerzan y se convierte en Greninja Ash. Su Shuriken de Agua también se ve potenciado.
battle-bond.detail: If this Pokemon is a Greninja, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. This effect can only happen once per battle.
battle-bond.detailEs: Transforma a este Pokémon en Greninja Ash tras debilitar a un rival. La potencia de Shuriken de Agua pasa a ser 20 y siempre golpea tres veces. Esta habilidad no puede copiarse ni reemplazarse. Esta habilidad solo surte efecto en Greninja.
battle-bond.detailZh: 此宝可梦击倒对手后变身为小智版甲贺忍蛙。飞水手里剑的威力变为20且必定攻击三次。此特性无法被复制或替换。此特性仅对甲贺忍蛙生效。
battle-bond.detailPt: Transforma este Pokémon em Ash-Greninja após nocautear um oponente. O poder de Water Shuriken passa a ser 20 e sempre acerta três vezes. Esta habilidade não pode ser copiada ou substituída. Esta habilidade só tem efeito para Greninja.

power-construct.textEn: If Zygarde 10%/50%, changes to Complete if at 1/2 max HP or less at end of turn.
power-construct.textEs: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, las células se reagrupan y adopta su Forma Completa.
power-construct.detail: If this Pokemon is a Zygarde in its 10% or 50% Forme, it changes to Complete Forme when it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP at the end of the turn.
power-construct.detailEs: Transforma a Zygarde al 10% o al 50% en su Forma Completa cuando sus PS están por debajo del 50%. Esta habilidad no puede copiarse ni reemplazarse. Esta habilidad solo surte efecto en Zygarde.
power-construct.detailZh: 当10%形态或50%形态的基格尔德HP低于50%时，变为完全体形态。此特性无法被复制或替换。此特性仅对基格尔德生效。
power-construct.detailPt: Transforma Zygarde 10% ou 50% na Forma Completa quando seu HP está abaixo de 50%. Esta habilidade não pode ser copiada ou substituída. Esta habilidade só tem efeito para Zygarde.

neuroforce.textEn: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.25x damage.
neuroforce.detail: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target have their damage multiplied by 1.25.
neuroforce.detailEs: Aumenta el daño supereficaz infligido a 1.25×.
neuroforce.detailZh: 使造成的效果绝佳伤害提升至1.25×。
neuroforce.detailPt: Aumenta o dano supereficaz causado para 1.25×.

pastel-veil.textEn: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. On switch-in, cures poisoned allies.
pastel-veil.textEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados del envenenamiento.
pastel-veil.detail: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while this Pokemon or its ally is poisoned cures them. If this Ability is being ignored during an effect that causes poison, this Pokemon is cured immediately but its ally is not.
pastel-veil.detailEs: Evita que el Pokémon y sus compañeros de equipo sean envenenados. También cura el envenenamiento de sus compañeros cuando entra en el campo de batalla.
pastel-veil.detailZh: 防止此宝可梦及其同伴陷入中毒状态。它出场时还会治愈同伴的中毒状态。
pastel-veil.detailPt: Impede que o Pokémon e seus companheiros de equipe sejam envenenados. Também cura o envenenamento dos companheiros de equipe quando ele entra no campo de batalha.

quick-draw.textEn: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.
quick-draw.textEs: A veces, puede atacar el primero.
quick-draw.detail: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.
quick-draw.detailEs: Si un Pokémon con esta habilidad selecciona un movimiento de daño, tiene un 30% de probabilidad de actuar primero dentro de su nivel de prioridad.
quick-draw.detailZh: 拥有此特性的宝可梦选择伤害招式时，有30%的几率在其先制度区间内率先行动。
quick-draw.detailPt: Se um Pokémon com esta Habilidade selecionar um movimento de dano, ele tem 30% de chance de agir primeiro dentro de sua faixa de prioridade.

curious-medicine.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.
curious-medicine.textEs: Al entrar en combate, rezuma una substancia medicinal por la caracola que revierte los cambios en las características de los aliados.
curious-medicine.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.
curious-medicine.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon entra en combate, esparce medicina desde su caparazón, lo que elimina todos los cambios de características de los aliados.
curious-medicine.detailZh: 此宝可梦出场时，会从壳里撒出药品，消除同伴的所有能力变化。
curious-medicine.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon entra em batalha, ele espalha remédio de sua concha, o que remove todas as mudanças de atributos dos aliados.

gorilla-tactics.textEn: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
gorilla-tactics.textEs: Potencia su Ataque, pero solo puede usar el primer movimiento escogido.
gorilla-tactics.detail: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while this Pokemon is Dynamaxed.
gorilla-tactics.detailEs: Aumenta el Ataque del Pokémon, pero solo permite usar el primer movimiento seleccionado.
gorilla-tactics.detailZh: 提升此宝可梦的攻击，但只能使用最先选择的招式。
gorilla-tactics.detailPt: Aumenta o Ataque do Pokémon, mas só permite o uso do primeiro movimento selecionado.

mimicry.textEn: This Pokemon's types change to match the Terrain. Type reverts when Terrain ends.
mimicry.textEs: Cambia su tipo según el campo que haya en el terreno de combate.
mimicry.detail: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.
mimicry.detailEs: Cambia el tipo del Pokémon según el campo que haya en el terreno.
mimicry.detailZh: 此宝可梦的属性会根据场地状态而变化。
mimicry.detailPt: Muda o tipo do Pokémon dependendo do terreno.

as-one-glastrier.textEn: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.
as-one-glastrier.textEs: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Blanco de Glastrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-glastrier.detail: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.
as-one-glastrier.detailEs: Esta habilidad combina los efectos de la habilidad Nerviosismo de Calyrex y la habilidad Relincho Blanco de Glastrier.
as-one-glastrier.detailZh: 此特性兼具蕾冠王的紧张感特性和雪暴马的苍白嘶鸣特性两者的效果。
as-one-glastrier.detailPt: Esta Habilidade combina os efeitos da Habilidade Unnerve de Calyrex e da Habilidade Chilling Neigh de Glastrier.

as-one-spectrier.textEn: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.
as-one-spectrier.textEs: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Negro de Spectrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-spectrier.detail: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.
as-one-spectrier.detailEs: Esta habilidad combina los efectos de la habilidad Nerviosismo de Calyrex y la habilidad Relincho Negro de Spectrier.
as-one-spectrier.detailZh: 此特性兼具蕾冠王的紧张感特性和灵幽马的漆黑嘶鸣特性两者的效果。
as-one-spectrier.detailPt: Esta Habilidade combina os efeitos da Habilidade Unnerve de Calyrex e da Habilidade Grim Neigh de Spectrier.

minds-eye.textEn: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Accuracy can't be lowered, ignores evasiveness.
minds-eye.textEs: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves
minds-eye.detail: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
minds-eye.detailEs: Ojo Mental permite al Pokémon con esta habilidad golpear a los Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de daño de tipo Normal y Lucha. También evita que otros Pokémon reduzcan la Precisión del Pokémon e ignora los cambios en la Evasión de los rivales.
minds-eye.detailZh: 心眼使拥有此特性的宝可梦能够用造成伤害的一般属性和格斗属性招式击中幽灵属性宝可梦。它还能防止其他宝可梦降低此宝可梦的命中率，并无视对手闪避率的变化。
minds-eye.detailPt: Mind's Eye permite que o Pokémon com esta Habilidade atinja Pokémon do tipo Fantasma com movimentos de dano dos tipos Normal e Lutador. Também impede que outros Pokémon diminuam a Precisão do Pokémon e ignora mudanças na Evasão dos oponentes.

tera-shell.textEn: Terapagos: If full HP, attacks taken have 0.5x effectiveness unless naturally immune.
tera-shell.textEs: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
tera-shell.detail: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos at full HP, the effectiveness of attacks against it is changed to 0.5 unless this Pokemon is immune to the move. Multi-hit moves retain the same effectiveness throughout the attack.
tera-shell.detailEs: El caparazón del Pokémon contiene el poder de todos los tipos. Todos los movimientos de daño que golpeen al Pokémon cuando tiene los PS al máximo no serán muy eficaces.
tera-shell.detailZh: 此宝可梦的甲壳蕴藏着各种属性的力量。当其HP全满时，所有击中此宝可梦的伤害招式都会变为效果不佳。
tera-shell.detailPt: A concha do Pokémon contém os poderes de cada tipo. Todos os movimentos de dano que atingirem o Pokémon quando seu HP estiver cheio não serão muito eficazes.

teraform-zero.textEn: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.
teraform-zero.textEs: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
teraform-zero.detail: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.
teraform-zero.detailEs: Cuando Terapagos cambia a su Forma Astral, usa sus poderes ocultos para eliminar todos los efectos del clima y del campo, reduciéndolos a cero.
teraform-zero.detailZh: 当太乐巴戈斯变为星晶形态时，会用其隐藏的力量消除天气和场地的所有影响，使之归零。
teraform-zero.detailPt: Quando Terapagos muda para sua Forma Estelar, ele usa seus poderes ocultos para eliminar todos os efeitos de clima e terreno, reduzindo-os a zero.

mega-sol.textEn: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
mega-sol.textEs: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
mega-sol.detail: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
mega-sol.detailEs: Aunque el sol no brille con intensidad, el Pokémon puede usar sus movimientos como si el clima fuera de sol intenso.
mega-sol.detailZh: 即使日照并未变得强烈，此宝可梦也可以如同在日照强烈的天气下一般使用招式。
mega-sol.detailPt: Mesmo quando a luz do sol não estiver forte, o Pokémon pode usar seus movimentos como se o clima fosse sol forte.

dragonize.textEn: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
dragonize.textEs: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
dragonize.detail: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
dragonize.detailEs: Los movimientos de tipo Normal del Pokémon se convierten en movimientos de tipo Dragón y su potencia aumenta un 20%.
dragonize.detailZh: 此宝可梦的一般属性招式变为龙属性招式，且威力提升20%。
dragonize.detailPt: Os movimentos do tipo Normal do Pokémon se tornam movimentos do tipo Dragão e seu poder é aumentado em 20%.

piercing-drill.textEn: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
piercing-drill.textEs: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
piercing-drill.detail: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
piercing-drill.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon usa movimientos de contacto, puede golpear incluso a los objetivos que se están protegiendo, infligiendo 1/4 del daño que el movimiento causaría normalmente. Todo lo demás, aparte de los efectos protectores del objetivo, se activa con normalidad.
piercing-drill.detailZh: 当此宝可梦使用接触类招式时，即使目标正在保护自己也能击中，造成该招式原本伤害的1/4。除目标的保护效果外，其他一切效果仍会正常触发。
piercing-drill.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon usa movimentos de contato, ele pode atingir até mesmo alvos que estejam se protegendo, causando 1/4 do dano que o movimento causaria normalmente. Tudo, exceto os efeitos protetores do alvo, ainda é acionado.

spicy-spray.textEn: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
spicy-spray.textEs: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
spicy-spray.detail: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
spicy-spray.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon recibe daño de un movimiento, quema al atacante.
spicy-spray.detailZh: 当此宝可梦受到招式伤害时，会使攻击方陷入灼伤状态。
spicy-spray.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon sofre dano de um movimento, ele queima o atacante.
